brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items were met with no serious or minor errors. The doctor demonstrated systematic acute risk triage (RC1), appropriate medication reconciliation (RC2), robust document verification via workspace queries (RC3), correct clinical prioritization (RC4), executable offline evaluation plans (RC5), verified patient teach-back and execution (RC6), and avoided overreach (RC7). HO1 was completed with multi-source verification of CT findings and renal status. HO2 was completed by correcting patient misconceptions about renal calcifications versus kidney failure. HO4 was completed by discovering and integrating prior renal/urologic history via workspace. Closure was valid with clear residual risks and executable follow-up.

Residual risks (left kidney structural changes, pulmonary nodule annual follow-up, gynecologic TCT result) are appropriately acknowledged and tracked.
